assessment: Understanding molecular and cellular pathways for endovascular invasion and pathogenesis of preeclampsia are important topics for current vascular biology and Ob/Gyn biology, making this study timely and important. It shows for the first time a causal link for the need of VE-cadherin on trophoblasts in vivo for the invasion of these cells into the decidua and for their role in vascular remodeling. The conclusions of this paper are well supported by data. It may provide a novel avenue for the prevention or treatment of preeclampsia.
